Based on the provided context, here is the comparison of the maximum paid sick leave between the two entities:

**GitLab BV (Belgium)**
*   **Maximum Paid Sick Leave:** **30 days** of full salary continuation.
*   **Details:** This applies regardless of seniority and runs concurrently with GitLab's global Sick Time policy.

**GitLab Canada Corp**
*   **Maximum Paid Sick Leave:** **25 working days** (supplemented by GitLab to 100% of regular salary).
*   **Details:** While employees have an annual allowance of 10 days, for extended sick leave (5+ days), GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days. (Note: There is an additional 25 working days available for *family care*, but the specific entitlement for the employee's own illness is capped at 25 working days for full salary supplementation).

**Difference:**
The maximum paid sick leave for the employee's own illness is **5 days longer** in Belgium (30 days) than in Canada (25 working days).

30 days full salary continuation, runs concurrently with GitLab's global Sick Time policy.

Sick Leave Details

- 30 days full salary continuation (regardless of seniority)
- Runs concurrently with GitLab's global Sick Time policy
- Designate as "Out Sick" in Workday
- Consecutive illnesses within 14 days count as one period unless medical certificate proves new illness

[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Time Away & Leave > Sick Leave]
**GitLab Canada Corp Entitlement**

- **Annual Allowance**: 10 days per year (3 days available after first month of employment)
- **Usage**: For illness, medical appointments, or caring for sick family members
- **Reporting**: Designate time as "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking

**Provincial Statutory Requirements**

- **Ontario**: 3 days job-protected unpaid sick leave (after 2+ weeks employment)
- **Quebec**: 2 days paid absence per calendar year

**Extended Sick Leave (5+ days)**

- GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days
- Additional 25 working days available for family care if not covered by provincial benefits
- Contact Absence Management team at leaves@domain.com
- Medical documentation may be required per local requirements

Provincial Leave Types and Request

Each province offers comprehensive leave entitlements including bereavement, family responsibility, critical illness, domestic violence, and specialized circumstances.

[GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Vacation Money (Vakantiegeld)]
* Statutory Sick Leave
  * Team members who are unable to work due to illness are entitled to 70% of their salary for up to 104 weeks. This leave runs concurrently with GitLab's [Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/). Team members will receive 100% of their salary for the first 25 days of illness.
  * GitLab complies with [Dutch local Laws](https://business.gov.nl/regulation/reporting-employee-illness-recovery/) regarding sick leave. Local laws override any leave policy we have in the benefit of the team members.
  * Team members must select `Out Sick` in Workday to ensure that all sick time is properly tracked. For complete reporting procedures, please review [the sick time procedure for The Netherlands here](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/).
* Statutory Vacation Leave
  * Team members are entitled to at least 20 vacation days per year which run concurrently with GitLab PTO. The days will accrue at 1.67 days/month from the team member's start date. Any unused days will be carried into the next calendar year, but expire on July 1st. Should the team member leave GitLab within the calendar year, an entitlement to a pro rata part vacation days exists. Team members must designate all vacation days taken as `Paid Time OFF` in Workday to ensure that vacation entitlement is properly tracked.
